productPageCtaAndListingStatus.detail: Every new-to-market reference in this complete source was opened on its exact official product page. Direct purchase and notify-me map to listed per user instruction; find-retailer-only maps to retailer-only. Existing rows were not individually reopened, so their historical listingStatus values were preserved. Follow-up: 1 existing exact product page CTA check(s) were recorded. Per-reference listing signals are separately recorded in data/evidence/longines/TW/2026-10-12/observations.json#/supplementalEvidence/existingCtaRecheck and are not represented as direct product-page CTA checks. Follow-up completed through 2026-10-13: attempted 542 references, confirmed 538 exact product pages at least once, could not reach 4 exact pages after retries, and left 0 confirmed-page CTA(s) unresolved. Full records: observations.json#/supplementalEvidence/existingProductPageCtaChecks.

independentOfficialSpotCheck.detail: Exact official product pages were checked for all new candidates. The required broad 19–21 representative sample of unchanged listings was not conducted. Follow-up: 2 absent-old-reference URLs were attempted; 2 redirected to market home, so no product-page CTA was inspected.

strictJsonAndSchema.detail: Strict JSON parsing rejected duplicate keys and invalid constants. Catalog/market/history instances validated against local schemas using the repository-pinned Ajv 6.15 compiler; the Draft 2020-12 metaschema URI was removed because this engine does not implement that metaschema, while local constraints, formats, references, and conditional rules compiled and passed.

formalWriteValidation.detail: Cross-brand validator passed all 43 market files. Official source refs and new prices reconcile; old market row objects were preserved; all old price series remain prefixes; only evidence-backed additions and status points were appended; protected markets and schemas were unchanged.

limitations: The broad independent 19–21 item sample of unchanged products was not run.
Germany source total and unique-reference count differ by one; its formal market/history remain unchanged pending resolution.
Evidence records observation date only; exact per-request timestamps were not retained.

Existing product-page CTA audit attempted all 542 references through 2026-10-13: 538 exact product pages were confirmed at least once, 4 could not reach an exact product page after retries, and 0 confirmed pages had unresolved purchase CTA. Full attempts are in observations.json supplementalEvidence.

2 representative absent-old-reference URLs redirect to the localized market home; together with absence from the complete market listing this supports market-specific not-listed, not global discontinuation.
